notes: All six packets implemented via the Gemini worker in one delegation; no deviations from the design or files_hint. Changes are confined to the allowed slots: prisma/schema.prisma (one `model Kudos` appended below the MODEL SLOT marker; datasource/generator/AppMeta byte-identical), src/modules/kudos/** (kudos.types.ts, kudos.prisma.ts, kudos.service.ts, kudos.controller.ts, kudos.module.ts), src/modules/index.ts (KudosModule registered in MODULES), and test/modules/kudos/** (kudos.service.spec.ts, kudos.registration.spec.ts). The module supplies its own PrismaService (extends PrismaClient, OnModuleInit/$connect + OnModuleDestroy/$disconnect) since the chassis ships no shared Prisma provider. Validation is hand-written (no class-validator dependency added) and follows the exact ordered pipeline: plain-object -> subset-keys -> present+string -> non-empty-after-trim -> max-length, throwing BadRequestException on first failure before any create. Verified in the containerized env: `pnpm build` (prisma generate + tsc) exits 0 and `pnpm test` exits 0 with 14 tests passing (9 service + 2 registration + 3 pre-existing chassis). Note: the worker requires GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT; it was set to the machine's configured gcloud project (ai-studies-console) with existing ADC to run the delegation.
